integration_requests.change: Integrate31 own Execute contracts with shared stable IDs, raw-storage semantics, fallback whitelist, suppressed failures, status sidechannel and batch publication. Preserve CUW distinction and duplicate master bindings.
Join current DS4 cache/materialization/connection by decorated ABI and callsites; no protocol-owner duplication.

Consumer schemas:0x226 keys4..8 or9, record+2/+4 u16 bit positions,+8 PID;0x10D key(category,bus),record+8 fullu16 protocol;0x105/0x12C record+6u16,0x142 dummy record+2u16; shared slot9 vehicle/u16 and0x1E flag/i32.

invariants: Every Execute receives one borrowed tagCOMMAND_DATA pointer, returns32-bit native status EAX and pops4 bytes. P3VSC decompiler pointer return is an inferred type error: instruction/status dataflow is u32.
All-required-input variants check command and borrowed pointers at command+0,+4,+0xC,+0x10; simple base, AA and1AB0 wrappers initially check command/output only. No extra pointer validation inferred.
Output m_lstCID at output+0x20 and count+0x30. Rows append unless DCM batch_replace explicitly assigns. AddTail status ignored. Empty supported lists can succeed without rows.
DeleteCidDataByteEnd(start) zeroes receive indices>=start, does not shrink count. Body trim15 retains at most12 payload bytes from receive3; EPB trim13 at most10.

Request bytes come from selected DS4 database materialization, not plugin filenames. Selector0xAC/0xAD supplies base CID support/read; helper changes send[2] to support ID. PID selector0x6B changes send[1] and frame+0x28=0xFF. SID22 bodies compare request/response bytes1,2 rather than hardcoding DID.

CCmdString SetAt is exact-length raw copy, not text truncation/capacity reservation. Fixed17-wide-unit output stores34 bytes including any untouched trailing ACP-buffer units; no silent normalization.

No plugin-local retry, cancellation polling, ECU reset or restore/disconnect added. Materialization/cache/send/connection belongs to PlatformSession; KGP core/protocol to TransportProtocols. Shared CID belongs to parent InformationReads. C++ allocation/conversion throws not converted to statuses.

base_support.cleanup: Destroy engine, cache, string, temporary list in reverse construction order on every ordinary status path. No plugin-local cancellation/retry/session-close operation; helper owns those mechanics.
base_support.inputs: command pointer and command+4 output required; other inputs delegated to Init. Initial output list is not cleared.
ordered_algorithm: Construct temporary string, cache, CID engine and optional staging list. InitCmdCommCidData(command,0xAC,0xAD); stop on nonzero.

GetSupportIdList(cache); stop on nonzero. Let n=GetSupportIdCount() (signed i32). For i=0..n-1 get support byte GetSupportId(i), GetCidData(byte,cache), optional DeleteCidDataByteEnd(trim_argument), StoreCidData(string,i). Each nonzero stops.
Append each string immediately or accumulate locally and append the complete batch only after all iterations succeed (per binding). AddTail return is ignored. n<=0 is success with no new entries.
base_support.output: CCmdStringName entries appended in support enumeration order, helper StoreCidData owns formatting and names. No rollback of previously appended entries for immediate mode.

Split remaining bytes into <=16-byte chunks and ACP-convert zero-terminated narrow buffers; SetAt(data,wide,17), append CID1,CID2,... . Empty remaining payload returns0.

Build temporary command with input/output zero, framectrl from original+0xC and data from+0x10. Load selector0x6B with explicit category; require exactly one frame AND request byte-list count>1, else0xC0040102. Set request[1].byte8=pid, frame byte+0x28=0xFF.

Construct CCmdSupportBitList(data,framectrl,category), CreatePid(category). Failure is suppressed to success after freeing buffers. GetPid(category) null also produces empty success.

Find first support-bit record with byte+8==pid; its unsigned byte+9 is expanded length. For each position j use support-record byte list at+0xC: mask[j].byte8==0 inserts zero; otherwise consume next packed response byte. Copy expanded bytes into zeroed256 buffer. No consume-count bound check.
If payload_count!=0 convert expanded_buffer+(start_bit>>3) by ACP, assign data. If no matching support record expanded buffer remains zero, producing empty string. Return0.

JSON_grammar.numbers: Leading zeros rejected; fractional and exponent markers require digits; fractional/exponent numeric conversion uses strtod.

JSON_grammar.strings: Reject unescaped control bytes<0x20, invalid escape characters, short/nonhex \u escapes and unterminated strings. Standard escapes and four-hex Unicode accepted; adjacent valid high/low surrogate pair combined and UTF8-encoded; raw non-ASCII bytes copied. Final application conversion still Windows ACP rather than UTF8.
JSON_grammar.trailing: Any non-whitespace trailing input rejects entire document.

GetFileDataFromType(1,&buffer) runs only after release of any previous buffer returns0. Nonzero file status becomes0xA0040005.

Parse entire NUL-terminated buffer as JSON using embedded parser. Whitespace is consumed, trailing non-whitespace is rejected. String lookup succeeds only for JSON type3 and nonempty narrow string. Object missing-key/wrong-type resolves library null value, not a fabricated default mapping.

On every exit after module construction: call FreeMemory(buffer:char*) if export and buffer are nonnull; set buffer=null regardless of status; zero function pointers; FreeLibrary(module); set module=null. Release status ignored by final destructor path; release JSON refcounts before source-buffer free.

ordered_algorithm: Load selector and require exact frame count specified. For each frame send normal SendReceive(frame,0). Require received_count>=expected-mask-count. For j<expected count require (received[j].byte8 & mask[j].byte8)==expected[j].byte8 (expected list at frame+0x6C).
Collect nonzero raw bytes after response offset2, stopping before NUL. P3VSC accumulates both successful replies in order; it tries second reply even if first fails.
Cap collected byte count to8(P39C) or12(P3VSC), ACP-convert zero-initialized narrow buffer, SetAt(data,wide,capped_count+1), append one CID1.

local.acp_string.algorithm: Measure narrow bytes through first NUL including terminator; MultiByteToWideChar(codepage=0,flags=0,input,measured_count,wide,measured_count). Inline wide storage capacity128 wchar; allocate zeroed wide storage when count>=129. ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER(122) triggers size query, resize and conversion retry, not ECU retry. local.acp_string.cleanup: Free dynamic wide buffer after imported CCmdString copies it; inline storage never freed.
local.acp_string.exceptions: Negative/invalid capacity=>0x80070057; allocation failure=>0x8007000E; other Win32 conversion error=>HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(error) when positive. Throw via _CxxThrowException, not plugin return status.

local.string_setat.output_implication: A fixed count17 stores34 bytes even when ACP conversion wrote a short string plus NUL; remaining units are native source-buffer contents and must not be described as zero padding or truncated variable storage. Display-visible prefix terminates at embedded NUL but serialized raw data may contain trailing uninitialized units.

Apply acceptance predicate from binding. For each received index, if expected-mask-list[index].byte8 !=0, collect received[index].byte8. Mask is selection boolean, NOT bitwise AND for these variants.
Optional HN narrow-space truncation stops BEFORE the first byte0x20. ACP-convert collected bytes; store by operator= or SetAt(length+1), then append one CID1.

For each first count responses require list length>=3 and concatenate bytes after offset3. Ignore extra response lists. Split concatenation into <=16-byte chunks, ACP-convert, SetAt(data,wide,17), append CID1,... .

Require signed received_count >= header_skip; verify request byte1==response byte1 and request byte2==response byte2. Plugin itself does not compare response service byte0.

Take response[header_skip:count], split consecutively into chunks of at most16 bytes (final short chunk admitted). Zero255 bytes of local narrow buffer and copy each chunk; ACP conversion includes terminating NUL. CCmdString::SetAt(data,wide,17). Append named prefix+decimal(i+1), preserving duplicates/existing rows.
